title: LA Rent Stabilization Ordinance (existence only)
reasons: The record contains no rent-increase rule. It only refers to the RSO in the context of an eviction filing requirement (the Landlord Declaration), which belongs to the eviction category, and it has no cap, coverage or exemption content.
